plain: A scientist named Filippo Biondi, who says he has scanned beneath the Egyptian pyramids, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 he went for the first time into the Serapeum of Saqqara. That is an underground site in Egypt lined with huge stone boxes, which he says are cut with striking precision. He tells it as part of his case that ancient Egypt held more advanced work than is usually believed.
